sql.value: select t.id, t.name, t.description, t.type, t.schema_json, t.url, t.auth_type, t.auth_value, t.http_method, t.builtin_handler, t.enable_status, t.sort, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time from ai_tool t where t.is_deleted=0 #[and t.name = :name] #[and t.type = :type] #[and t.builtin_handler = :builtinHandler] #[and t.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by t.sort desc, t.id desc
